encounter: E0200 TRAINER_GARRISON (AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F, Feather Badge, cap 48, Medium)
availability_audit: The Abandoned Ship is reached by Surf on Route 108 after the Balance Badge; battle index window 48-60, floor 48. Every member is gated at 36 or below in pool-48.json: Thwackey line (36), Torracat line (36), New Mauville interior via Wattson's Basement Key (30), Haunter plus Linking Cord (30), Granite Cave Abra plus Slateport Linking Cord (20), Togepi Route 102 plus Shiny Stone (24). All precede the first Surf. No legendaries, Ultra Beasts or Paradox species.
plan: All four of Garrison's are physical and all four are Rock-types, which decides both halves of the plan. On defence, Incineroar's Intimidate taxes every single attacker on the team on entry, and Gengar's Levitate blanks Alolan Golem's Stomping Tantrum outright. On offence, Grass is 4x on both Carracosta and Relicanth and 2x on Alolan Golem, so Rillaboom is the engine again - and Grassy Glide matters specifically because Carracosta's whole plan is Shell Smash, and priority ignores the Speed it gains. Iron Hands' Fighting is 2x on three of the four. Gengar's Taunt is the cleanest answer to the SETUP flag, since it blanks Shell Smash and Swords Dance at once. Deliberately no Magnezone this time: Alolan Golem carries both Stomping Tantrum and Fire Punch, which are 4x and 2x into an Electric/Steel body.
